# Payload reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs. Edit types.ts or the generator. -->

The wire format is version **1**. The tables below are generated from `packages/core/src/types.ts` by `pnpm --filter docs build`. A question mark marks an optional field. These are TypeScript declarations, not runtime validation; validate incoming data in your receiver.

`createdAt` is an ISO 8601 string. Collector timestamps (`t`) and network durations are milliseconds; timestamps use Unix epoch time. Rectangles and page dimensions use CSS pixels. `rect` is viewport-relative; `docRect` includes the scroll offset. Screenshot pixels may differ by device pixel ratio.

`attachments` contains metadata only. Binary files travel as separate multipart fields named by `name`; a selection's `crop` points to one of those fields. A custom `send` receives an additional array of `Attachment` objects with a `blob: Blob` field. See [Backend](./backend.md).

Component names, sources and props depend on what the host framework exposes. Missing debug metadata is normal in production. `note.transcript` can be supplied through the core draft API; the widget has no voice recorder.

Default ring-buffer limits are 200 console entries, 50 errors, 100 network entries and 100 breadcrumbs. Request/response bodies are disabled unless explicitly enabled, and then only captured for same-origin requests. Strings captured by collectors and element inspection are bounded; application context should be kept small and safe by the host.

## ElementSelection

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code>id</code> | <code>string</code> |  |
| <code>kind</code> | <code>'element' &#124; 'region'</code> | &#96;element&#96; for a single click, &#96;region&#96; for a dragged rectangle. |
| <code>selector</code> | <code>string</code> |  |
| <code>context?</code> | <code>ElementContext[]</code> | Root boundaries to traverse before resolving selector; omitted for the reporting document. |
| <code>tag</code> | <code>string</code> |  |
| <code>elementId?</code> | <code>string</code> |  |
| <code>classes</code> | <code>string[]</code> |  |
| <code>text</code> | <code>string</code> |  |
| <code>attrs</code> | <code>Record&lt;string, string&gt;</code> |  |
| <code>rect</code> | <code>Rect</code> | Reporting document viewport-relative rect at selection time, clipped to containing frames. |
| <code>docRect</code> | <code>Rect</code> | Document-relative rect (rect + scroll offset), for overlaying on full-page screenshots. |
| <code>framework</code> | <code>'react' &#124; 'vue' &#124; null</code> |  |
| <code>components</code> | <code>string[]</code> | Component chain from the element outward, e.g. ["InvoiceRow", "InvoiceTable", "Dashboard", "App"]. |
| <code>chain</code> | <code>ComponentInfo[]</code> | Same chain with per-component source locations when available. |
| <code>source?</code> | <code>SourceLocation</code> | JSX call site of this element in a dev build, or a &#96;data-source&#96; attribute stamped by a build plugin. |
| <code>props?</code> | <code>Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;</code> | Sanitized props of the nearest component (functions, elements and children stripped, depth-limited). |
| <code>crop?</code> | <code>string</code> | Attachment name of a cropped screenshot of this selection, when one was captured. |
| <code>region?</code> | <code>{ rect: Rect; docRect: Rect; children: ElementSummary[] }</code> | Region selections only: the dragged rectangle and the visible elements it contains. |
| <code>note?</code> | <code>string</code> | Note the reporter attached to this specific element. |
| <code>html?</code> | <code>string</code> | Short HTML snippet (outerHTML trimmed) for extra context. |
| <code>sensitive?</code> | <code>boolean</code> | Inside a sensitive subtree: text, classes, attributes, props and HTML are withheld. |

Map a docRect onto the image by subtracting &#96;area.x&#96;/&#96;area.y&#96; and scaling by &#96;imageWidth / area.width&#96;.
